affected_system: cross-agency public-service access, workload, quality, and outcome distribution
alternatives: activate a bounded reserve from forecast risk bands for population-specific eligible service need and capacity
use rolling forecasts and conservative capacity triggers for population-specific eligible service need and capacity
pair denominator, eligibility, season, and access-conditioned forecasting with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Need, eligibility, access, requests, service, quality, and outcomes remain separate measures.
Protected and vulnerable group reporting follows privacy, legal, and small-cell safeguards.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: continue ordinary capacity planning for population-specific eligible service need and capacity.

constraints.description: The distributional public-service equity forecast must respect declared validated operational capacity and forecast uncertainty.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: chief equity officer and city performance director
decision_question: What group- and area-specific eligible need and service-capacity range should planning prepare for?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The distributional public-service equity forecast must respect declared validated operational capacity and forecast uncertainty.
independence_key.decision_object: population-specific eligible service need and capacity
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for population-specific eligible service need and capacity passes documented checks for held-out error, interval coverage, event detection, drift, and baseline comparison.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: denominator, eligibility, season, and access-conditioned forecasting
independence_key.primary_outcome: eligible need above minimum service capacity

intended_claim: A versioned forecast design for comparing declared alternatives affecting population-specific eligible service need and capacity, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: eligible need above minimum service capacity
distributional gap in eligible need above minimum service capacity
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not call forecast eligible need individual demand, behavior, entitlement, or verified unmet service.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for population-specific eligible service need and capacity passes documented checks for held-out error, interval coverage, event detection, drift, and baseline comparison.

title: Forecast service need and capacity by population group
transportability_risks: Rights, demographics, service rules, need measurement, geography, and reporting access differ.
Administrative denominators may omit eligible or underserved populations.
